<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-0616-54-32" status="unreviewed"><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">kha 1</rs> na re spyi bkag pas bye brag khegs don dam dngos med dngos med kyi bye brag yin kyang buM pa la dngos med rnam bcad la khegs pa'i phyir gyi rtags ma grub lo | dngos 'gal gzhi 1 la 'dus par
               <lb n="27b9"/>yang mi 'gyur te dngos po dngos med tsam dngos 'gal ma yin | dngos po tsam yin tsam ma yin dngos 'gal yin yang gzhi 1 la mi 'du ba'i phyir zhes zer | 'di rigs pa ma yin te don dam dngos med dngos med kyi bye brag yin na shes bya la dngos med bkag pa 'dra srid dam mi srid 2 pa ltar na bu bkag pa yang mi srid do byas na mtshungs | dang po ltar na dngos Na bkag
            
            <pb n="28a"/>
            
               <lb n="28a1"/>| pa'i shes bya de cos can don dam dgos md kyang khegs par 'gyur 'dod na don dam dngos por thal lo | gzhan yang buM pa de la dngos po tsam ma yin khegs pa'i phyi don dam dngos po tsam ma yin yang khegs par <expan>'gyur ro</expan> | de 'dod na don dam dngos po tsam yin du <expan>thal lo</expan> |</seg></TEI>
